name: Ambre Saddle
description: Rich Mysore sandalwood infused with caramelized bourbon vanilla, cinnamon bark, and golden amber.

name: Mistiq
description: Cool aquatic freshness of crisp mint, lavender, and coriander over ocean breeze, settling into soft sandalwood, musk, and light amber.

name: Oudwood
description: Smooth, refined oud blended with exotic rosewood, warm cardamom, and sandalwood, finishing in vetiver, tonka bean, and amber.

name: Royal Black
description: Bold, dark oriental statement of spiced saffron and black pepper over smoky oud, leather, and rich amber with a velvety musk base.

name: Breez
description: Juicy fruity-aquatic burst of green apple, bergamot, and lemon with plum and cinnamon, drying down to ambergris, vanilla, musk, and woods.

name: Tocco
description: Opulent blend of sun-cured tobacco leaf and creamy vanilla with warm spices, cacao, tonka bean, and dried fruits.

name: Ruby
description: Radiant floral-fruity sparkle of yuzu and pomegranate with icy accord, blooming peony, magnolia, and lotus, over soft musk, amber, and woods.

name: Shanya
description: Radiant floral-fruity sparkle of yuzu and pomegranate with icy accord, blooming peony, magnolia, and lotus, over soft musk, amber, and woods.

name: Rose Vanille
description: Velvety Bulgarian rose wrapped in sweet creamy vanilla, with warm cashmeran, sandalwood, and soft white musk.

name: Victus
description: Energetic sporty-fresh grapefruit, mandarin, and marine notes with bay leaf, driving into guaiac wood, patchouli, oakmoss, and ambergris.

name: Dominus
description: Confident fruity-smoky signature of pineapple, bergamot, blackcurrant, and apple over birch, musk, oakmoss, ambergris, and vanilla.

name: Garden Rose
description: Fresh-cut garden rose petals with soft dewy greens and a gentle hint of musk, like a blooming courtyard in the morning.

name: Raat Rani
description: Intoxicating night-blooming jasmine, sweet and heady, that turns every evening into a fragrant garden retreat.

name: Lime
description: Zesty, sparkling lime peel with a crisp citrus twist that instantly wakes up and freshens your space.

name: Lavender
description: Calming French lavender with soft herbal and woody undertones, made for peaceful evenings and restful sleep.
